name: memory_search
description: Full-text search over stored facts. Requires at least 'query' or 'category'. Plain words match facts containing all of them (common stopwords ignored, match=all_terms). If none do, facts containing any of them are returned (match=some_terms). Supports "exact phrase", -exclude (needs at least one positive term), UPPERCASE AND/OR/NOT, and entity_name:/tags:/content: filters. Results are ordered by rank (BM25, lower is better).

query.description: Search text. May be omitted when category is given (returns the most recent facts in that category, match=category).

category.description: Restrict to one category. May be used without query to list newest category facts.
